import requests, os, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.chdir('/tmp')
def get(u): return requests.get(u,timeout=90).content
open('SLC10A7_AF.pdb','wb').write(get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q0GE19-F1-model_v6.pdb'))
open('7ZYI.pdb','wb').write(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/7ZYI.pdb'))
fa={k:get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta').decode() for k,a in [('A7','Q0GE19'),('A1','Q14973')]}
seqs={k:''.join(l.strip() for l in v.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>')) for k,v in fa.items()}
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def ca(fn,ch):
    d={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[12:16].strip()=='CA' and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip() in aa3:
            d[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return d
caN=ca('7ZYI.pdb','A'); caA=ca('SLC10A7_AF.pdb','A')
# reuse compact BLOSUM NW
B="A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V\nA 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0\nR -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3\nN -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3\nD -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3\nC 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1\nQ -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2\nE -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2\nG 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3\nH -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3\nI -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3\nL -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1\nK -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2\nM -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1\nF -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1\nP -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2\nS 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2\nT 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0\nW -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3\nY -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1\nV 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"
rows=B.splitlines(); cols=rows[0].split(); S={}
for r in rows[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): S[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
scf=lambda a,b:S.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,g=-6):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    H[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*g;H[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*g
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+scf(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]);u=H[i-1,j]+g;l=H[i,j-1]+g
            b=max(d,u,l);H[i,j]=b;T[i,j]=0 if b==d else(1 if b==u else 2)
    a1=a2='';i,j=n,m
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and T[i,j]==0:a1=s1[i-1]+a1;a2=s2[j-1]+a2;i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and(j==0 or T[i,j]==1):a1=s1[i-1]+a1;a2='-'+a2;i-=1
        else:a1='-'+a1;a2=s2[j-1]+a2;j-=1
    return a1,a2
aA,aB=nw(seqs['A7'],seqs['A1']); iA=iB=0; mp={}
for x,y in zip(aA,aB):
    if x!='-':iA+=1
    if y!='-':iB+=1
    if x!='-' and y!='-':mp[iB]=(iA,x,y)
pairs=[(mp[p][0],p) for p in mp if mp[p][0] in caA and p in caN]
P=np.array([caA[a] for a,b in pairs]);Q=np.array([caN[b] for a,b in pairs])
def kab(P,Q):
    Pc=P-P.mean(0);Qc=Q-Q.mean(0);H=Pc.T@Qc;U,_,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R,P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
# iterative core fit
mask=np.ones(len(P),bool)
for _ in range(8):
    R,pm,qm=kab(P[mask],Q[mask])
    dev=np.linalg.norm((R@(P-pm).T).T-(Q-qm),axis=1)
    mask=dev<3
core=np.sqrt((dev[mask]**2).mean())
ntcp_pos=np.array([b for a,b in pairs])

# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax[0].plot(ntcp_pos,dev,lw=0.8,color='steelblue')
ax[0].axhline(3,ls='--',c='grey'); ax[0].fill_between(ntcp_pos,0,dev,where=dev<3,alpha=.2,color='green')
for p in [68,99,105,119,123,257]:
    if p in ntcp_pos: ax[0].axvline(p,color='red',alpha=.5,lw=0.7)
ax[0].set_xlabel('NTCP residue (7ZYI)');ax[0].set_ylabel('Cα deviation after core fit (Å)')
ax[0].set_title(f'SLC10A7(AF) vs NTCP core fit\ncore RMSD={core:.2f}Å over {mask.sum()} res; red=Na-site')
# Na site table
na=[('Q68','Na1 sc+bb','gap','—','ABSENT'),('S99','Na1 bb','M114','Met','lost'),
    ('S105','Na2 OG','S120','Ser','IDENTICAL'),('S119','Na2 OG','A135','Ala','lost'),
    ('T123','Na2 OG1','S139','Ser','hydroxyl kept'),('E257','Na2 OE2','D267','Asp','carboxylate kept')]
ax[1].axis('off')
cellcol=[]
for row in na:
    c='#b6e3b6' if row[4] in('IDENTICAL','carboxylate kept','hydroxyl kept') else '#f2b6b6'
    cellcol.append(['white','white','white','white',c])
tb=ax[1].table(cellText=na,colLabels=['NTCP res','role','SLC10A7','aa','verdict'],
    cellColours=cellcol,loc='center',cellLoc='center')
tb.auto_set_font_size(False);tb.set_fontsize(9);tb.scale(1,1.6)
ax[1].set_title('NTCP Na+-site residues mapped to SLC10A7\n(alignment 26.4% id; pLDDT 86-94 at these sites)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('slc10a7_vs_ntcp.png',dpi=130)
print("core RMSD",round(core,2),"over",int(mask.sum()),"residues; pairs",len(pairs))
print("Na2: 1 identical(S105>S120), E257>D267(carboxylate kept), T123>S139(OH kept), S119>A135(lost)")
print("Na1: Q68 no aligned equiv, S99>M114(lost)")
print("FIGURE saved slc10a7_vs_ntcp.png")
